```text
canon-engineering gates
Usage: gates [COMMAND]

Commands:
  validate  Parse, type-check and plan every assertion without collecting observations
  explain   Explain the checked plan, resolved requests and bound implementation identities
  run       Collect all planned observations, retain evidence and evaluate the gate
  evaluate  Replay retained evidence without executing commands, providers or network operations
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `validate`

```text
Parse, type-check and plan every assertion without collecting observations

Usage: validate [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --file <FILE>
          Gates document, relative to root

          [default: .engineering/gates.yaml]

      --root <ROOT>
          Source root whose dirty and untracked files enter the evidence identity

          [default: .]

      --project <PROJECT>
          Explicit command/provider/variable registration; omitted means no process admission

      --base <BASE>
          Revision the change is measured from; `git.changed` is unknown without it

      --subject <SUBJECT>
          Revision under test; `git.changed` is unknown without it

      --story-id <STORY_ID>
          The story the change belongs to; `story.id` is unknown without it

      --story-tag <STORY_TAGS>
          A tag of that story, repeatable; giving none leaves `story.has_tag` unknown

      --default-search-path <DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATH>
          Directory, repeatable, where a command's `program` is looked up when the project has no `search_path`; it must be absolute and outside the tree

  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `run`

```text
Collect all planned observations, retain evidence and evaluate the gate

Usage: run [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --file <FILE>
          Gates document, relative to root

          [default: .engineering/gates.yaml]

      --root <ROOT>
          Source root whose dirty and untracked files enter the evidence identity

          [default: .]

      --project <PROJECT>
          Explicit command/provider/variable registration; omitted means no process admission

      --base <BASE>
          Revision the change is measured from; `git.changed` is unknown without it

      --subject <SUBJECT>
          Revision under test; `git.changed` is unknown without it

      --story-id <STORY_ID>
          The story the change belongs to; `story.id` is unknown without it

      --story-tag <STORY_TAGS>
          A tag of that story, repeatable; giving none leaves `story.has_tag` unknown

      --default-search-path <DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATH>
          Directory, repeatable, where a command's `program` is looked up when the project has no `search_path`; it must be absolute and outside the tree

      --out <OUT>
          Evidence output under .engineering/assertions/, relative to root

          [default: .engineering/assertions/evidence.json]

      --now <NOW>
          Evaluation instant in Unix seconds; the edge reads the clock when omitted

  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `evaluate`

```text
Replay retained evidence without executing commands, providers or network operations

Usage: evaluate [OPTIONS] --evidence <EVIDENCE>

Options:
      --evidence <EVIDENCE>


      --now <NOW>
          Defaults to the retained evaluation instant for reproducible replay

      --source-identity <SOURCE_IDENTITY>
          Expected source identity. A mismatch makes the retained evidence unavailable

      --context-identity <CONTEXT_IDENTITY>


  -h, --help
          Print help

```
